subject: Annual commitment: invoice interop & payment-sweep trigger plan
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@brightlane.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-25T15:02:00Z
Subject: Annual commitment: invoice interop & payment-sweep trigger plan

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for committing to the annual package. Before we finalize the SOW, I want to confirm the payment-sweep cadence you prefer and how BrightLane wants VAT evidence to be surfaced. Proposed approach:

- Quarterly invoicing (advance) with a monthly sweep option if you want faster consumption alignment.
- We can expose a single CSV ledger for your AR + a monthly PDF invoice.
- VAT: we will attach country-level VAT proof per invoice; confirm if a VAT-registered entity in NL or DE is preferred.

Attached: draft schedule and an invoice template. Can you confirm preferred sweep window (1st of month vs. 15th) and the AR contact we should route remittance to?

Cheers,
Lukas Meyer
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachment: BrightLane_Commitment_Schedule_Q4_2029.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Invoice_Template_BL-78341.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@brightlane.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Receivable <accounts@brightlane.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@brightlane.com>
Date: 2028-10-26T08:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Annual commitment: invoice interop & payment-sweep trigger plan

Thanks Lukas —

Quarterly advance invoicing works for us, but we prefer a monthly automated sweep to simplify cash forecasting. Ideal sweep date is the 5th of each month (local CET). VAT evidence should list our NL VAT number and country breakdown per line item. AR contact is accounts@brightlane.com (please copy Tom for any payment exceptions).

One request: can Redwood include a single reconciliation CSV each month that maps invoice line items to usage buckets? That’ll help our internal tagging.

Best,
Sophie Lang
Head of Finance, BrightLane Analytics
--
On 2028-10-25, Lukas Meyer wrote:
> Attached draft schedule and invoice template. Can you confirm preferred sweep window and AR contact?

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@brightlane.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-26T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Annual commitment: invoice interop & payment-sweep trigger plan

Appreciate the quick reply, Sophie — that works.

Confirmed actions:
- We’ll set up monthly sweep on the 5th CET.
- Redwood will emit monthly CSV reconciliation that maps invoice lines to model/route usage (field mapping included).
- VAT proof will include NL VAT + country breakdown.

Priyom/Kim: can you confirm we can enable the 5th sweep window for DL-78341 and include the CSV fields Sophie requested? I’ve started a draft entry in HubSpot (HubSpot-123456).

Lukas
Attachment: BrightLane_Commitment_Schedule_Q4_2029.pdf (pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-27T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Annual commitment: invoice interop & payment-sweep trigger plan

Lukas — quick ops note.

We can schedule the sweep on the 5th CET. Two operational constraints:
1) Sweep buffer: allow a 48-hour collection window to pick up late remittances from banking cutoffs (we’ll attempt on the 5th and finalize movement by EOD 7th CET).
2) CSV reconciliation: proposed columns: invoice_id, line_item_id, model_id, route_tag, tokens_consumed, amount_eur, vat_rate, country_code. Is that sufficient for BrightLane?

Marcus: finance will need the final invoice PDF + CSV pushed to SFTP and cc accounts@brightlane.com. Also flag for EU VAT Z reporting — Kim, can you confirm export format for EU VAT registry?

Thanks —
Priyom
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@brightlane.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Annual commitment: invoice interop & payment-sweep trigger plan

All — final confirmation below (following Marcus’s ledger test):

- Monthly automated sweep on 05th CET, with a 48-hr finalize window (movement completes by 07th EOD CET).
- Deliverables per sweep: PDF invoice (standard template), CSV reconciliation (columns as proposed), and a VAT proof PDF broken out by country.
- Delivery channels: SFTP push to brightlane-payments, CC to accounts@brightlane.com, HubSpot invoice record updated (HubSpot-123456).
- Internal owner: Marcus Lin will run the first two sweeps for validation.

Sophie — we’ll run a dry-run on Nov 05 (no funds will be moved) and share the CSV+PDF for you to validate mapping. If that looks good we’ll enable live sweep for December cycle.

Attachments: Invoice_Template_BL-78341.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Billing Lead | Redwood Inference
--
Marcus Lin will kick off the dry-run on Nov 05 and send a validation email to accounts@brightlane.com.
